Form No.
G. 2500-11-33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.2, Special Branch
Date January 8, 1934.

（右上角印章内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / File No. / No. D. 5610 / Date 8th Jan., 1. 34.）

Subject (in full) Anti-Imperialist and anti-Kuomintang Propaganda.

Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by A. O. Smeeton

I forward herewith a number of coloured slips of
paper bearing anti-Imperialist and anti-Kuomintang slogans
which were found by the Municipal Police on Darroch Road
near North Szechuen Road on the early morning of January 5,1934.
Although no mention is made of the source, it is
believed that the propaganda emanates from the Chapei District
Committee of the local Chinese Communist Party. A translation
of the slogans is also attached.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

File
AOS

报告
特二科（S.2, Special Branch）
日期：1934年1月8日。

（右上角印章内容：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与特别处登记室 / 档案号 / 编号 D. 5610 / 日期 1934年1月8日。）

事由（全称）：反帝及反国民党宣传。

呈报人：督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：A. O. Smeeton

现随文附上若干张印有反帝及反国民党标语的彩色纸条，这些纸条系1934年1月5日清晨由公共租界巡捕在北四川路附近的达罗克路（Darroch Road）发现。虽未提及来源，但据信该宣传品出自当地中国共产党闸北区委员会。标语译文亦附后。

顾宝华
督察

特务科主管警官。

存档
AOS

pages.en:
Section 2, Special Branch,
January 8, 1934.

Anti-Imperialist and Anti-Kuomintang Propaganda

A number of coloured slips of paper
bearing the following slogans were found by the
Municipal Police on Darreck Road near North
Szechuen Road on the early morning of January 5:-
(1) Overthrow the Fascist Clique which is engaged
in kidnapping and torturing anti-Imperialist
warriors!
(2) Effect the emancipation of the Chinese nation
by overthrowing the Kuomintang which is the
running dog of the Imperialists!
(3) The Kuomintang betrays our national rights
and butchers labourers, peasants and poor
people!
pages.zh:
特务科第二股，
1934年1月8日。

反帝及反国民党宣传

1月5日清晨，公共租界巡捕在北四川路附近的达雷克路（Darreck Road）发现若干张印有如下标语的彩色纸条：
(1) 推翻从事绑架和拷打反帝战士的法西斯集团！
(2) 推翻作为帝国主义走狗的国民党，实现中华民族解放！
(3) 国民党出卖我国权，屠杀劳工、农民和贫民！

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-I-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. ________
Mis. 2.
Dixwell Road ________ Station,
Date 5-1-34 ________ 19

REPORT

Subject (in full) Communistic pamphlets found on the Darrock Road.

Made by ________________________ Forwarded by D. S. Self

Sir,
At about 7-30.a.m. 5-1-34 J. P. C. 24 on patrol on the Darrock
Road near North Szechuen Road, found strewed on the roadway, a quan-
tity of small pieces of paper, some 3 inches in length and ½ inch
in width, on which were printed in Chinese characters, Communistic
sentiments.
Enquiries were made in the neighbourhood by D. S. Mc'arale and
C. D. S. 224 but no information as to how the pamphlets arrived there,
could be gained.

D. D. O. "C" Div.                                            D. Self.
                                                             D. S. J.

Copy forwarded to the Political Section.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

档案号 ________
杂项 2.
狄思威路 ________ 捕房，
日期 34年1月5日 ________ 19时

报告

事由（全称）：在达罗克路发现的共产主义小册子。

呈报人 ___ 转呈人：D. S. Self

先生，
1934年1月5日上午7时30分左右，警员编号24（J. P. C. 24）在北四川路附近的达罗克路巡逻时，发现路面上散落着大量长3英寸、宽½英寸的小纸片，上面用汉字印有共产主义言论。
警司麦卡勒（Mc'arale）和华籍巡长编号224（C. D. S. 224）在附近进行了查询，但未能获得关于这些小册子如何出现在此处的任何信息。

“C”区副总监                                            D. Self.
                                                             D. S. J.

副本已送交政治股。
